text:
Ivy: Heads-up: we'll be running a cross-channel retarget + search cadence for Gradient next week. Need to finalize pacing and a creative fallback plan.
Sam: Proposed pacing: start low (20%) for 6 hours to gather signals, then spike to 100% for 4 hours, followed by 30% sustain. Use a creative fallback (static) if animated fails to load.
Renee: Creative update: have 2 animated + 2 static hero variants, 5 headline ideas. I'll label IDs in the drive. Can we A/B test motion vs static in retarget?
Omar: For retarget segments: last 30d visits, pricing page, signup flow abandoners. High-intent = pricing OR watched demo>50%. Give high-intent 1.8x.
Zoe: Lead routing: webhook to HubSpot and Amplitude. Hot lead rule: form_completed && time_on_site>6m -> assign to webinar SDRs and ping #sdr-wave.
AdOpsBot: scheduled rule window created for 2024-12-10T15:00:00Z (canary on).
Ivy: Also want a soft-dedicated UK copy test at 5% traffic. If UK CTR vs baseline delta > 0.5pp, roll to 20%.
Sam: Budget cap set at $10k/day. Add burnout guard: pause if CPA > 200 for rolling 3h.
Renee: QA checklist: TY pixel, form_id mapping, mobile countdown, asset fallback.
Omar: We'll upload offline conversions after the webinar.
Ivy: Good. Post final creative filenames and audience IDs before 9am PT tomorrow. Sync 10am PT.
Sam: I'll post the JSON ad rule later.
Ivy: Thanks team :sparkles:
